source_text: In northern Ghana, despite national bans, FGM persists at rates of 61% in areas like Bawku Municipality due to beliefs that it preserves virginity, reduces promiscuity, and distinguishes tribal identities, with uncircumcised girls facing ridicule, isolation, and exclusion from social events. [124]
